</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Full-time Corporate Auditors and Directors disclose adequate information to Outside Corporate Auditors, such as by giving prior explanations on agenda to be proposed to the Board of Directors.&#160;&#160;In addition, a Corporate Auditors Department has been established as a specialized independent organization to assist the Corporate Auditors.</font></div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 27pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">2.</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Matters pertaining to functions relating to the execution of duties, audit and supervision, appointment and<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font>decisions regarding<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font>remuneration, etc. (Outline of the current corporate governance system)</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC has formulated and announced Toyota Global Vision in March 2011 based on what we have learned from the deterioration of business environment after the Lehman Shock and the series of quality problems.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left">The Toyota Global Vision, based on Toyota&#8217;s values that have guided us since Toyota&#8217;s <font style="BACKGROUND-COLOR: transparent; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">founding</font> such as &#8220;Guiding Principles of Toyota&#8221; and &#8220;Toyota Way,&#8221; aims to exceed customer expectations in the development of &#8220;ever-better cars&#8221; and &#8220;enriching lives of societies,&#8221; and to be rewarded with a smile which ultimately leads to the &#8220;stable base of business.&#8221;&#160;&#160;Toyota is to keep this virtuous cycle focusing &#8220;always better cars.&#8221;</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">To fulfill the Toyota Global Vision, Toyota will make some changes in our management structure such as &#8220;reducing the Board of Directors&#8221; and the &#8220;decision-making layers.&#8221;&#160;&#160;Toyota will continue to offer products and services that will satisfy evolving needs in every region.&#160;&#160;TMC headquarter will provide an overall direction and furnish support for the initiatives undertaken by the regional operations.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Specifically, with the aim of faster decision-making, TMC is to drastically reduce the number of Directors with the approval at the general shareholders meeting in June 2011.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div id="PGBRK" style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">- 6 -</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Furthermore, TMC will shift three-layer arrangement &#8211; Executive Vice President, Chief Officer, and Executive responsible for the operations involved &#8211; to two layers: eliminate the executive immediately below the Chief Officer.&#160;&#160;Moving forward with this new structure will support a swifter flow of information from the divisional general managers, who are intimately familiar with their operations, to senior management.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC is to enhance clarity in organizational responsibilities: Board of Directors decide what Toyota will do as global Toyota, Chief Officers decide how to implement our decision as chief executives for day-to-day operations, etc.&#160;&#160;The post of Chief Officer will be filled either by &#8220;Senior Managing Officer&#8221; or &#8220;Managing Officer&#8221; in a flexible manner.&#160;&#160;Chief Officers responsible for the region or function conduct local operations basically at respective sites under Executive Vice President responsible for each operational sector to vigorously reflect voices of local customers into functions of R&amp;D, production, and sales.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC has an &#8220;International Advisory Board&#8221; consisting of advisors from each region overseas, and, as appropriate, receives advice on a wide range of management issues from a global perspective.&#160;&#160;In addition, TMC has a wide variety of conferences and committees for deliberations and the monitoring of management and corporate activities that reflect the views of various stakeholders, including the &#8220;Labor-Management Council, the Joint Labor-Management Round Table Conference&#8221;, the &#8220;Toyota Environment Committee&#8221; and the &#8220;Stock Option Committee&#8221;.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In order to manage and implement important activities for fulfilling social responsibilities, TMC has established the &#8220;CSR Committee&#8221; consisting of directors at the executive vice president level and above as well as representatives of corporate auditors, to review important issues relating to corporate ethics, legal compliance, risk management and social contribution, and also to develop action plans concerning these issues.&#160;&#160;TMC has also created a number of facilities for employees to make inquiries concerning compliance matters, including the Compliance Hotline, which enables them to consult with an outside attorney, and takes measures to ensure that TMC is aware of significant information concerning legal compliance as quickly as possible.&#160;&#160;TMC will continue to promote the &#8220;Toyota Code of Conduct&#8221; which is a guideline for employees&#8217; behavior and conduct for employees of TMC and its consolidated subsidiaries (together &#8220;Toyota&#8221;) all around the world.&#160;&#160;TMC will work to advance corporate ethics through training and education at all levels and in all departments.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 27pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC has adopted an auditor system.&#160;&#160;Seven Corporate Auditors including four Outside Corporate Auditors play a role in TMC&#8217;s corporate governance efforts by undertaking audits in accordance with the audit policies and plans determined by the Board of Corporate Auditors.&#160;&#160;In addition, TMC has secured the personnel and framework supporting the audit by Corporate Auditors.&#160;&#160;The Outside Corporate Auditors advise TMC from a fair and neutral perspective, based on their broad experiences and insight in their respective field of expertise. The state of internal controls and internal audit are reported to Corporate Auditors (including Outside Corporate Auditors) through the Board of Corporate Auditors and the &#8220;CSR Committee&#8221;, and the status of accounting audits is reported by independent External Auditors to the Corporate Auditors (including Outside Corporate Auditors) through the Board of Corporate Auditors. To enhance the system for internal audit, a specialized organization made independent of direct control by the management evaluates the effectiveness of the system to secure the appropriateness of documents regarding financial calculation and other information in accordance with Section 404 of the U.S. Sarbanes Oxley Act and Article 24-4-4 (1) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Law of Japan.&#160;&#160;In order to enhance the reliability of the financial reporting of TMC, the three auditing functions, audit by Corporate Auditors, internal audit, and accounting audit by Independent External Auditors, aid in conducting an effective and efficient audit through meetings held periodically and as necessary to share information and come to understandings through discussion on audit plans and results.</font></div>

<td align="left" valign="top" width="78%" style="BORDER-BOTTOM: black 2px solid; BORDER-LEFT: black 2px solid; BORDER-RIGHT: black 2px solid">
<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC has long engaged in business with the idea of corporate social responsibility (&#8220;CSR&#8221;) in mind.&#160;&#160;This idea is clarified in the CSR Policy &#8220;Contribution towards Sustainable Development &#8220;, and it clearly conveys TMC&#8217;s basic policies concerning CSR to both internal and external stakeholders.&#160;&#160;Regarding the environment, TMC has positioned it as a top management priority and adopted the &#8220;Toyota Earth Charter&#8221; in 1992.&#160;&#160;TMC created &#8220;Toyota Environmental Action Plan&#8221; that sets forth mid-term targets and action plans on a global basis, and promotes continuous environmental preservation activities.&#160;&#160;As for philanthropic activities, TMC newly adopted &#8220;Basic Philosophy and Policy on Philanthropic Activities&#8221; in 2005 in light of the global expansion of its business and the increasing societal expectations towards Toyota.&#160;&#160;TMC vigorously promotes philanthropic activities according to local conditions in each country and region in order to contribute to the development of a prosperous society and to promote its continuous development.&#160;&#160;These CSR activities are disclosed in the report titled &#8220;Sustainability Report&#8221;.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 27pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC, together with its subsidiaries, has created and maintained a sound corporate climate based on the &#8220;Guiding Principles at Toyota&#8221; and the &#8220;Toyota Code of Conduct.&#8221; TMC integrates the principles of problem identification and continuous improvement into its business operation process and makes continuous efforts to train employees who will put these principles into practice.</font></div>

</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will properly manage the capital fund through its budgeting system and other forms of control, conduct business operations, and manage the budget, based on the authorities and responsibilities in accordance with the &#8220;Ringi&#8221; system (effective consensus-building and approval system) and other systems. Significant matters will be properly submitted and discussed at the Board of Directors&#8217; meeting and other meetings of various bodies in accordance with the standards stipulated in the relevant rules.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will ensure accurate financial reporting by issuing documentation on the financial flow and the control system, etc., and by properly and promptly disclosing information through the Disclosure Committee.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>

</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Basic Policy and Preparation towards the Elimination of Antisocial Forces</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>

<div>
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 36pt">&#160;</td>
<td align="right" style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">(1)</font></div>
</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Basic Policy for Elimination of Antisocial Forces</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 54pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Based upon the &#8220;Guiding Principles at Toyota&#8221; and the &#8220;Toyota Code of Conduct&#8221;, TMC&#8217;s basic policy is to have no relationship with antisocial forces. TMC will take resolute action as an organization against any undue claims and actions by antisocial forces or groups, and has drawn the attention of such policy to its employees by means such as clearly stipulating it in the &#8220;Toyota Code of Conduct&#8221;.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div>
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">

<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 36pt">&#160;</td>
<td align="right" style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">(2)</font></div>
</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Preparation towards Elimination of Antisocial Forces</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">

<td style="WIDTH: 54pt">&#160;</td>
<td align="right" style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">1)</font></div>
</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Establishment of Divisions Overseeing Measures Against Antisocial Forces </font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">and Posts in Charge of Preventing Undue Claims</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 73pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC established divisions that oversee measures against antisocial forces (&#8220;Divisions Overseeing Measures Against Antisocial Forces&#8221;) in its major offices as well as assigned persons in charge of preventing undue claims. TMC also established a system whereby undue claims, organized violence and criminal activities conducted by antisocial forces are immediately reported to and consulted with Divisions Overseeing Measures Against Antisocial Forces.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">

<td style="WIDTH: 54pt">&#160;</td>
<td align="right" style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">2)</font></div>
</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Liaising with Specialist Organizations</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 73pt">

</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC has been strengthening its liaison with specialist organizations by joining liaison committees organized by specialists such as the police. It has also been receiving guidance on measures to be taken against antisocial forces from such committees.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Matters regarding defense against a takeover bid</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 27pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">No measures to defend against a takeover bid are scheduled to be adopted.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">

</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Matters regarding other corporate governance systems, etc.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Company Structure and Procedures Regarding Timely Disclosure</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The following describes Toyota&#8217;s company structure and procedures regarding the timely disclosure of Company information.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">(</font>Guiding Principles)</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Toyota practices its guiding principle of disclosing operating results, business and financial information in a timely and appropriate manner.&#160;&#160;Such guiding principles are set forth in &#8220;Contribution towards Sustainable Development&#8221; which explains the &#8220;Guiding Principles at Toyota.&#8221;</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">(</font>Disclosure Committee and its Purpose)</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Toyota has established a Disclosure Committee that is chaired by the officer responsible for the accounting division in an effort to ensure that the information disclosed is accurate, fair and timely.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Disclosure Committee meets periodically to draft, report and assess annual and quarterly reports prepared pursuant to the Japanese Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, and annual reports prepared pursuant to the U.S. Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended.&#160;&#160;The Disclosure Committee also holds meetings on an ad hoc basis as necessary.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">(Procedures of the Disclosure Committee)</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Disclosure Committee performs the following procedures:</font></div>

<div>
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 27pt">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">(1)</font></div>
</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Collection of information</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Proposed resolutions and reference matters</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Proposed Resolution 1: Distribution of Surplus</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We propose the distribution of surplus as follows:</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Year-end Dividend</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 27pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We will strive for the stable and continuous payment of dividends while giving due consideration to factors such as business results for each term, investment plans, and our cash reserves.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 27pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In order to survive tough competition, we will focus on the early commercialization of technologies for the next-generation environment and safety, giving priority to customer safety and security.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 27pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Considering these factors, we would like to offer a year-end dividend of 30 yen per share. Combined with the interim dividend, the total amount of the annual dividends for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2011 will be 50 yen per share.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">To Our Shareholders:</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">I would like to express our gratitude for your ongoing support and understanding of our company.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We offer our sincere prayers for the repose of the souls who died in the East Japan Earthquake, and our deepest sympathies to those who suffered from the disaster.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We will continue to provide the utmost support to those now in the disaster area and we are working to expedite the restoration of manufacturing in the Tohoku area as soon as possible.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In March of this year, we announced the &#8220;Toyota Global Vision,&#8221; a vision for the future plotted out based on the lessons we have learned from the harsh business conditions in the aftermath of the Lehman Shock and a series of quality issues we have faced.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Through the efforts of all of us at Toyota for business recovery, and in response to the quality issues, I have reached out and made contact with various related people such as members of the media and customers around the world. These experiences have led me to feel anew the importance of expressing in writing what kind of company we are and what kind of values we hold, and making these things known to the public at large, our shareholders, customers, and employees.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our management under the Vision is built upon the founding values and <font style="FONT-STYLE: italic; DISPLAY: inline">Monozukuri</font> commitment to conscientious manufacturing shared by all of us at Toyota, as expressed in the &#8220;Toyoda Precepts,&#8221; the &#8220;Guiding Principles at Toyota,&#8221; and the &#8220;Toyota Way.&#8221; Our contributions to &#8220;better towns and better society&#8221; through the creation of &#8220;always better cars&#8221; that exceed customer expectations will help us establish a &#8220;stable base of business&#8221; for Toyota. We believe that we will enhance our corporate value and meet shareholders expectations by fostering this virtuous cycle.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">After considering various factors such as our business results, research and development activities, and investments planned for sustainable growth, we would like to propose a year-end dividend of 30 yen per share at the FY2011 Ordinary General Shareholders&#8217; Meeting in order to maintain our tradition of providing stable and continuous returns to shareholders. This, combined with the interim dividend of 20 yen per share, will result in a total annual dividend of 50 yen per share for FY2011.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Since April of this year we have been successively making changes in our management structure, including our systems to &#8220;reduce layers in decision making&#8221; and &#8220;reduce the number of directors.&#8221; We have been conducting community-based corporate activities and providing products and services that only Toyota can afford to provide to the specific towns and countries that need them. In the future, our global headquarters in Japan will plan out an overall direction and furnish further support for initiatives undertaken by the regional operations.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Toyota has encountered numerous challenges in the 74 years since its foundation. We have overcome these challenges in every situation we faced, encouraged by the smiles we earned from customers worldwide and the concept of creating socially beneficial automobiles. All 300,000 of us at Toyota worldwide will take part in the work to lay foundations for sustainable growth. Toyota will advance, never turning back, through these concerted efforts. We look forward to your ongoing support.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">President</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Attachment to the Notice of Convocation of FY2011 Ordinary General Shareholders&#8217; Meeting</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Business Report <font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">(Fiscal Year under review: April 1, 2010 through March 31, 2011)</font></font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">1. Outlook of Associated Companies</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(1) Progress and Achievement in Operation</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">General Economic Environment in FY2011</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Reviewing the general economic environment for the fiscal year ended March 2011 (&#8220;FY2011&#8221;), the world economy is improving mainly due to the effect of the expansion of domestic demands and exports in emerging countries especially in Asia, and the economic stimulus measures undertaken by various countries. Although the Japanese economy has gained momentum from improved corporate revenues and rallies in exports and production, it is still facing dire challenges linked to the persistently low employment figures and to the weakened economic activity resulting from the impact of the Great East Japan Earthquake.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">For automobile industry, market has expanded especially in emerging countries such as China, and technological development and new product launches have been accelerated, caused by increase of customers&#8217; demands for the compact cars and low-price cars, and growth of worldwide environmental consciousness.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Overview of Operations</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In this business environment, Toyota Motor Corporation (&#8220;TMC&#8221;) and its consolidated subsidiaries (together &#8220;Toyota&#8221;) have striven to manufacture &#8220;good automobiles&#8221; that will be accepted by our customers and society to meet with our founding mission of &#8220;contributing to society through the manufacture of automobiles.&#8221; One example is the &#8220;Etios,&#8221; a small-size vehicle launched for the Indian market last year. It was developed with the help of numerous Indian engineers and with direct consumer input. It has already earned good reputation from many customers. Toyota will continue to manufacture automobiles which meet customer needs in every country of the world including the emerging countries. The &#8220;Vitz,&#8221; a core model of the Toyota brand, was fully redesigned to meet customer&#8217;s diversifying compact-car needs, while pursuing one class higher in terms of quality, comfort, ease of use and affordability. For the Lexus brand, Toyota launched the &#8220;CT200h,&#8221; the first hybrid-only model in the premium-compact segment.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As a result of launching the new products that meet needs of customer in Japan and other countries, vigorous sales efforts with dealers in every country and region, expansion of market in emerging countries, and demand-boosting measures, in various countries, such as eco-car subsidies and tax-reductions in Japan, global vehicle sales for FY2011, including the Daihatsu and Hino brands, increased by 284 thousand units </font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">(or 3.5%) from FY2010 to a total of 8,423 thousand units.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We have made steady headway in our efforts to improve profit structure, by the strenuous efforts with all of </font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">the Toyota group to reduce fixed costs and implement thorough cost-improvement activities.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">To cope with the quality issues that have emerged from the beginning of last year, we have been making improvements by establishing a Special Committee for Global Quality to investigate all causes of the quality problems such as process of design, manufacture, sales, service, and human resource development.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In addition to these activities, we agreed with Tesla Motors Inc., in May of last year to work jointly on electric vehicle development. Toyota will revisit to its founding mission as a venture company in the past by emulating the challenging spirit, quick decision-making, and flexibility that Tesla Motors has, and Toyota will take on the future challenges. Toyota will be changing its management structures in order to enable prompt management decisions based on our customer voices and information from front-line operations in each region, and to continuously check whether our management decisions are acceptable by society. Toyota will also implement other measures, including a review of the decision-making system by directors and the establishment of advisory boards in major regions such as North America, Europe, and Asia.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The consolidated financial results for FY2011 reflect the sharp appreciation of the yen and the influence of the Great East Japan Earthquake of March of this year. Consolidated net income attributable to Toyota Motor Corporation increased by 198.7 billion yen (or 94.9%) to 408.1 billion yen compared with FY2010.</font></div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Environmental Initiatives</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Toyota considers addressing environmental issues as one of its top management priorities, and proactively works for the realization of a low-carbon society.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">First of all, Toyota is endeavoring to further improve fuel efficiency by developing a high-efficiency gasoline engine. Toyota&#8217;s steps to expand its product line-up of hybrid vehicles and reinforce quality improvements and cost reductions for the hybrid system have resulted in accumulated sales of hybrid vehicles exceeding 3 million units in Japan and abroad. We are also making all-around efforts to develop next-generation eco-cars such as plug-in hybrid vehicles, electric vehicles, and fuel cell vehicles to satisfy the requests of customers and society.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Additionally, as for new trials towards the realization of a low-carbon society, Toyota is participating in the large-scale Plug-in Hybrid demonstration experiment in Strasbourg, France and smart grid demonstration experiments in Boulder, Colorado in the U.S.A., Toyota-shi in Aichi, and Rokkasho-mura in Aomori, Japan.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Non-Automotive Operations</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In non-automotive operations, we are actively developing businesses to meet diverse customer needs. Our financial services has been steadily providing financial support to help societies to realize &#8220;a rich car life,&#8221; responding to various risks, and providing financial services customized to customer needs and regional characteristics through an expanded network covering 34 countries and regions of the world. Our housing business was transferred to Toyota Housing Corporation in October 1, 2010. We intend to respond quickly to customer requests by organizing integration and enhanced specialty in the housing business as well as prompt decision-making and flexible business management through joint efforts of development, production, and marketing.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(2) Funding</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Capital investment in the automotive business is mainly financed with funds gained from business operations. Funds necessary for the financial services business are mainly financed through the issuance of bonds and medium-term notes, as well as from borrowings. The balance of debt as of the end of FY2011 was 12,401.0 billion yen.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(3) Capital Expenditures</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As for capital expenditures, Toyota streamlined investment by making more effective use of its existing facilities. At the same time, Toyota focused its investment into &#8220;Eco-Cars,&#8221; including hybrid vehicles, and &#8220;emerging markets&#8221; which have strong potential for their growth. As a result of these efforts towards efficient investment, consolidated capital expenditures for FY2011 were 642.3 billion yen.</font></div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(5) Issues to be Addressed</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As for our future business environment, although the emerging economies are expected to continue expanding, particularly in China and India, and the developed economies such as the United States and Europe are expected to continue recovering at a moderate pace, we must closely watch the various risks, such as the risks of rising oil prices and the continuing high unemployment rate in the United States and Europe. The Japanese economy is expected to pick up gradually as well, backed by recovering economies overseas and the various effects of government policies.&#160;&#160;However, the damage by the Great East Japan Earthquake was widespread and serious, and will continue to significantly affect the Japanese economy, and the momentum of Japan&#8217;s economic recovery will weaken for the time being.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">There were many Toyota production bases, dealers, and suppliers in the disaster-stricken areas, and they suffered serious damage. The Toyota group, in concerted efforts, will focus on speedy rehabilitation as a top priority.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">While the automotive market is expected to expand over the medium- to long-term, particularly in emerging countries, competition in the automotive market for compact cars and low-price cars will intensify and eco-cars may face fierce competition on a global scale.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In this severe business environment, the Toyota group as a whole will make an even greater effort to address the following in order to realize two of Toyota&#8217;s enduring wishes: &#8220;to be a company customers choose&#8221; and &#8220;to bring smiles to every customer who chooses Toyota.&#8221;</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">First, in product development, we intend to proceed with substantial improvement in design and perceived quality and the establishment of organization by which products launched at a certain region will be developed based on the customer needs of such region. For &#8220;Eco-Cars&#8221;, we will make all-around efforts to expand our product line-up of hybrid vehicles and develop next-generation eco-cars such as plug-in hybrid vehicles, electric vehicles and fuel cell vehicles, along with the high-efficiency gasoline engine.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Second, as for &#8220;emerging markets&#8221; with strong promise for future growth, we intend to reinforce core models for local production such as IMV and newly developed compact vehicles, while launching more hybrid vehicles. Through these efforts, we will build a well-balanced business structure that impartially allocates resources to both developed countries and emerging countries.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">(*) IMV is an abbreviation for Innovative International Multi-purpose Vehicle, which refers to sport-utility vehicles (SUVs), pickup trucks, and other multi-purpose vehicles that is produced overseas for markets worldwide.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Third, to quickly reflect feedback from our customers around the world in our R&amp;D, production and sales operations, we will build a structure wherein decisions can be made regionally, in areas closest to the customers.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Fourth, we will further reinforce three basic functions: quality improvement, cost reduction, and human resource development.</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Based on these efforts, Toyota will contribute to realize &#8220;enriching lives of communities&#8221; through</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left">&#160;</div>

<div id="PGBRK" style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">9</font></div>

<div style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left">&#160;</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">manufacturing&#160;&#160;&#8220;good automobiles&#8221; that is accepted by customers and society. This will encourage more customers to well-purchase Toyota cars and thereby lead to the establishment of a stable business base. By perpetuating this good cycle, we will aim to realize &#8220;sustainable growth&#8221; and enhance corporate value. And, through full observance of corporate ethics such as compliance with applicable laws and regulations, Toyota will fulfill its social responsibilities by carrying out its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). Even under the difficult circumstances, we will meet challenging goals by engaging the talent and passion of people, who believe there is always a better way. We sincerely hope that our shareholders will continue to extend their patronage and support to us.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(6) Policy on Distribution of Surplus by Resolution of the Board of Directors</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC deems the benefit of its shareholders as one of its priority management policies, and it continues to work to improve its corporate structure to realize sustainable growth in order to enhance its corporate value.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will strive for the stable and continuous payment of dividends while giving due consideration to factors such as business results for each term, investment plans and its cash reserves.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In order to survive tough competition, TMC will utilize its internal funds mainly for the early commercialization of technologies for the next-generation environment and safety, giving priority to customer safety and security.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC pays dividends twice a year &#8211; an interim dividend and a year-end dividend &#8211;, and in order to secure an opportunity to directly seek shareholders&#8217; opinions, TMC will treat payments of year-end dividends as a matter to be resolved at the FY2011 Ordinary General Shareholders&#8217; Meeting, even though TMC&#8217;s articles of incorporation stipulate that retained earnings can be distributed as dividends pursuant to the resolution of the board of directors.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will not repurchase its own shares for the time being, as it decided to prioritize securing its cash reserves in consideration of uncertainties in the future global economic condition.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 27pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">It is a policy of TMC that, if it is deemed that the Accounting Auditor will have difficulty in conducting an audit appropriately because of the occurrence of an event stipulated in laws or regulations or an event that interferes with the eligibility or independence of the Accounting Auditor, TMC shall determine whether to dismiss or refrain from reappointing the Accounting Auditor, as needed.</font></div>

<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block">&#160;</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">6. Basic Policy Regarding the System to Secure the Appropriateness of Business</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC, together with its subsidiaries, has created and maintained a sound corporate climate based on the &#8220;Guiding Principles at Toyota&#8221; and the &#8220;Toyota Code of Conduct.&#8221; TMC integrates the principles of problem identification and continuous improvement into its business operation process and makes continuous efforts to train employees who will put these principles into practice.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Accordingly, TMC has developed its basic policy regarding the following items as stipulated in the Corporation Act.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC partially revised the Basic Policy Regarding the System to Secure the Appropriateness of Business in line with the changes in management structures described in &#8220;1. Outlook of Associated Companies.&#8221;</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(1)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">System to ensure that the Directors execute their responsibilities in compliance with relevant laws and regulations and the Articles of Incorporation</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">1)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will ensure that Directors act in compliance with relevant laws and regulations and the Articles of Incorporation, based on the Code of Ethics and other explanatory documents that include necessary legal information, presented on occasions such as trainings for new Directors.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">2)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will make decisions regarding business operations after comprehensive discussions at the Board of Directors&#8217; meeting and other meetings of various cross-sectional decision-making bodies. Matters to be decided are properly submitted and discussed at the meetings of those decision-making bodies in accordance with the relevant rules.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">3)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will appropriately discuss significant matters and measures relating to issues such as corporate ethics, compliance, and risk management at the CSR Committee and other meetings. TMC will also discuss and decide, at the meetings of various cross-sectional decision-making bodies, policies and systems to monitor and respond to risks relating to organizational function.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(2)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">System to retain and manage information relating to performance of duties by Directors</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 18pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Information relating to exercising duties by Directors shall be appropriately retained and managed by each division in charge pursuant to the relevant internal rules and laws and regulations.</font></div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(3)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Rules and systems related to the management of risk of loss</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">1)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will properly manage the capital fund through its budgeting system and other forms of control, conduct business operations, and manage the budget, based on the authorities and responsibilities in accordance with the &#8220;Ringi&#8221; system (effective consensus-building and approval system) and other systems. Significant matters will be properly submitted and discussed at the Board of Directors&#8217; meeting and other meetings of various bodies in accordance with the standards stipulated in the relevant rules.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

</div>
</div>

<div>&#160;</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">2)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will ensure accurate financial reporting by issuing documentation on the financial flow and the control system, etc., and by properly and promptly disclosing information through the Disclosure Committee.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">3)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will manage various risks relating to safety, quality, the environment, etc. and compliance by establishing coordinated systems with all regions, establishing rules or preparing and delivering manuals and by other means, as necessary through each relevant division.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">4)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As a precaution against events such as natural disasters, TMC will prepare manuals, conduct emergency drills, arrange risk diversification and insurance, etc. as needed.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(4)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">System to ensure that Directors exercise their duties efficiently</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">1)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will manage consistent policies by specifying the policies at each level of the organization based on the medium- to long-term management policies and the Company&#8217;s policies for each fiscal term.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">2)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The Directors will promptly determine the management policies based on precise on-the-spot information and, in accordance with Toyota&#8217;s advantageous &#8220;field-oriented&#8221; approach, delegate a high level of authority to Chief Officers (Senior Managing Officers and Managing Officers) who take responsibility for business operations in each region and function. The Chief Officers will proactively compose business plans for the regions and functions under their leadership and execute them in a swift and timely manner in order to carry out Toyota&#8217;s management policies. The Directors will supervise the execution of duties by the Chief Officers.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">3)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC, from time to time, will make opportunities to listen to the opinions of various stakeholders, including external experts in each region, and reflect those opinions in TMC&#8217;s management and corporate activities.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; DISPLAY: block"><br>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">

<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">(5)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">System to ensure that employees conduct business in compliance with relevant laws and regulations and the Articles of Incorporation</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">

</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">1)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will clarify the responsibilities of each organization unit and maintain a basis to ensure continuous improvements in the system.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">

</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">2)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will continuously review the legal compliance and risk management framework to ensure effectiveness. For this purpose, each organization unit shall confirm the effectiveness by conducting self-checks among others, and report the result to the CSR Committee and other committees.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">

</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will promptly obtain information regarding legal compliance and corporate ethics and respond to problems and questions related to compliance through its corporate ethics inquiry office and other channels.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">System to ensure the appropriateness of business operations of the corporation and the business group consisting of the parent company and subsidiaries</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Arial">
<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 8pt">&#160; </font></div>
</td>
<td style="WIDTH: 18pt">
<div style="TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">1)</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">TMC will expand the &#8220;Guiding Principles at Toyota&#8221; and the &#8220;Toyota Code of Conduct&#8221; to its subsidiaries as Toyota&#8217;s common charter of conduct, and develop and maintain a sound environment of internal controls for Toyota. TMC will also promote the &#8220;Guiding Principles at Toyota&#8221; and the &#8220;Toyota Code of Conduct&#8221; through personnel exchanges.</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div>

<tr valign="top" style="LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25;">
<td style="WIDTH: 17pt">
